action_type.summary: Article describes four union confederations holding a press conference, not an outdoor/public mass action.

threshold.summary: No audience/participant number or 50+ gathering evidence in the consulted passage.

demand.summary: Unions sought suspension/revision of government employee census and consultation; conference format and threshold remain absent.

decision: Do not count as event: press conference by union representatives is not evidence of an executed qualifying public gathering of 50+.
